description: Records visual content and messages locally for replay. Includes visible source text. Reload the window to start or change command recording. Disabling recording takes effect immediately.
heading: Local Session Replay

description: Sends recorded visual content and messages to the backend. Independent of local recording. Reload the window to start or change command recording. Disabling recording takes effect immediately.
heading: Upload Session Replay

description: Allows session replay uploads without signing in when sessionReplay.uploadEnabled is enabled. Existing authentication is still used when available. The allowAnonymous=true URL parameter also permits anonymous uploads. Reload the window to start or change command recording. Disabling recording takes effect immediately.
heading: Allow Anonymous Session Replay Uploads
